subject: design/local-work-tracker-v2
statement: list/filter (by state and by signal name *or role*) and full-text search (over title, body, and log) are **direct scans** of the item files — no index in v1 (Q3). At the PRD's NFR-2 capacity (10⁴ items) a scan of small files on local SSD meets NFR-1 (< 200 ms p95), pinned by a 10k-item fixture (A-10). If scale ever breaches it, an index is added under one rule: decision-path reads bypass it (DINV-4); until measured, an index is a temptation, not a requirement.
